Date: Sat, 22 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ: VM assurance & closure evidence exchange

Hi Grace,

Hope you're well. I'm working through the SIG/CAIQ evidence collection for FinTrust and we need a focused vulnerability management packet from Redwood covering: scan cadence (tool + frequency), SLA commitments for CVE remediation by severity (High/Critical), and an index of scan artifacts that map to the SIG control ids.

Specifically we need:
- A compact scan-index (CSV) that lists scan date, scanner name/version, asset scope, and top findings (CVE id + severity).
- Your stated SLA for remediation windows and any documented exception/escape process.
- CVE resolution manifests or remediation evidence for any active High/Critical items within the last 90 days.
- Any compensating control notes for items under extended remediation.

Can you provide a consolidated packet by EOD PT on Tuesday (2028-07-24)? If that's not feasible, a staged delivery (index first, then full manifests) is fine — please confirm the timeline.

Also include a primary contact for follow-up questions. If there are any items that must remain internal due to customer data restrictions, call that out so we can coordinate a redacted exchange.

Thanks — low friction here helps us clear the SIG intake.

Best,
Marta Ruiz
SIG Intake Analyst
SIG Assess Ltd.

--
Note: We will reference SIG intake ID SIG-FT-2028-07 in our tracker.
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>

Marta — thanks for the clear ask and SIG ID. We can get a consolidated packet to you by EOD Tuesday. Plan below and owners:

- Scan index (CSV): Jonas will export the last 6 months of authenticated and unauthenticated scans, include scanner metadata and top findings. ETA: 2028-07-23 15:00 PT.
- CVE resolution manifest (PDF): Jonas + David will produce per-CVE entries showing triage, assigned owner, mitigation/patch PR, and deployment date where available. ETA: 2028-07-24 EOD PT.
- SLA statement (short doc): Kimberly will confirm our internal remediation windows and the exceptions process; I'll include the compensating controls language. ETA: 2028-07-24 EOD PT.

Deliverables will be: vuln-scan-index.csv, cve-resolution-manifest.pdf, and a sig-evidence-checklist.xlsx that maps files to SIG control ids. We will flag any customer-sensitive items explicitly; for those we will provide redacted artifacts and a separate call if you need unredacted evidence.

Primary contact for this packet: Jonas Weber (jonas.weber@redwood.com). He owns the scan exports and will handle most questions; David Kim will handle triage details and exception rationale.

If that's acceptable, we'll upload the packet to the secure Drive link and email you the DocuSign acknowledgment request so you can confirm receipt.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

- vuln-scan-index.csv: contains last 6 months of scans across auth/unauth contexts. Columns: scan_date, scanner, scanner_version, asset_tag, ip, cve, severity, finder_count, remediation_status. A small sample included in the CSV (first 10 rows) and full index in the Drive link.
- cve-resolution-manifest.pdf: CVE-level rows with triage date, owner, mitigation type (patch/compensating control), PR/CL link if applicable, deploy date, notes.

Notes on a few CVEs:
- CVE-2028-1042 (Critical): Mitigated by hotfix on 2028-07-15, evidence in manifest (PR #4872, deploy tag v2.4.8).
- CVE-2028-1987 (High): Under staged rollout — mitigation merged, scheduled production deploy 2028-07-26; we will provide post-deploy evidence once live.
- Two low/medium third-party library items are on extended remediation due to compatibility testing; documented compensating controls included in manifest.

If SIG needs the raw scan bundles (Nessus/Qualys exports) we can provide an access window — please confirm whether redacted exports are sufficient.

Jonas Weber
Security Ops (Vulnerability Management)
Redwood Inference

I confirmed with FinTrust Security Ops that the provided exports and manifest cover SIG-FT-2028-07 scope. A couple small clarifications before we close the intake:

1) For the CVEs you marked as "staged rollout", please confirm an expected evidence deliverable (post-deploy diff or vulnerability rescan) and an ETA for that artifact.
